what: External public files used by the stage 3b subtype classifier (decision D6). Metadata only; the files themselves are git-ignored under data/external/.

files.citation: Verhaak et al. 2010, Cancer Cell 17:98-110, doi:10.1016/j.ccr.2009.12.020; GDC publication page https://gdc.cancer.gov/about-data/publications/gbm_exp ('Expression values and subtype calls for the Core TCGA samples using the unified scaled data')
files.use: The 840-gene ClaNC signature (gene list used) and the labels of the 173 core samples. Labels come from consensus average-linkage hierarchical clustering of 202 samples on 1,740 genes; core samples are those with positive silhouette width (paper, Results). Not used as training labels: only 45 of the 283 expression patients are core samples.

files.citation: Verhaak et al. 2010; same GDC page ('ClaNC 840 gene list and centroids')
files.use: Published microarray centroids. Downloaded for provenance; not used (the centroids here are re-estimated on TCGA RNA-seq).

files.citation: Verhaak et al. 2010; same GDC page ('A list of the 202 samples used for analysis')
Brennan et al. 2013, Cell 155:462-477, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2013.09.034; GDC publication page https://gdc.cancer.gov/about-data/publications/gbm_2013 (SI Table S7)
files.use: Training and reference labels ('Cluster'). Provenance per sample: 'CanCellPaper 2010' = INCLUDED carries the Verhaak 2010 consensus-clustering label; the others 'were classified into one of classes using single sample gene set enrichment analysis' (Brennan 2013, Results, 'Molecular subclasses defined by global mRNA expression'). G-CIMP is reported as a separate group. One patient (TCGA-07-0227) has two all-NA rows.

files.citation: Ceccarelli et al. 2016, Cell 164:550-563, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2015.12.028; GDC publication page https://gdc.cancer.gov/about-data/publications/lgggbm_2016 ('AWG Clinical Supplementary Info'; served as TableS1.PatientData.20151020.v3.xlsx)
files.use: Cross-check only: 'Original Subtype' agrees with Brennan 2013 'Cluster' on all 524 GBM patients labelled in both. Not used for training.
Member HGNChelper/data/hgnc.table.rda (previous HGNC symbol -> approved symbol) resolved 94 retired symbols of the 840. Read with pyreadr; nothing executed.
